title: Doing Life
plot_overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man develop an unexpected connection through heartfelt letters. As they share their lives, their bond opens the possibility of hope, love, and a second chance, even as others may struggle to see him beyond his circumstances.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like heartfelt dramas about family, second chances, and unlikely connections; Not for you if you prefer fast-paced plots or stories without a romantic focus.
review_summary: Pros: heartfelt story; moving themes; engaging leads | Cons: familiar romance; fateful moments; uneven appeal
